exposure: no clinical evidence of asphyxia at birth
cohort: Infants born with cord pH ≤ 7.0 and no clinical evidence of asphyxia at birth, compared to healthy infants with normal cord pH
finding: Abnormal cord pH in otherwise healthy neonates was not associated with an increased risk of abnormal neurodevelopmental outcome or severe health problems by 2 years of age after adjusting for birth weight.
